description: Bounded universal quantification preserves formulas that are \(\Sigma_1\) up to PA equivalence. The witnesses are collected by an internal beta code.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.sigmaOne_bounded_universal {k : ℕ}
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit))
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term (Fin k))
  (hφ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.SigmaOneEquivalent φ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.SigmaOneEquivalent
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.boundedAll t φ)
